## Tracy Jensen for Mayor of Alameda: Experience We Can Count On. Values We Share.
Tracy Jensen is running to be Mayor of Alameda, because our city needs steady, responsible, and proven leadership during this challenging time.
A current City Councilmember and former member of the Alameda School Board and Alameda Health Care District Board, Tracy Jensen brings years of experience serving Alameda. Indeed, she’s the only candidate with the state, local, and federal experience to ensure Alameda has the resources necessary to continue our progress.
Click map to enlarge | Download map (PDF)
Tracy is passionate about human rights, economic development, and environmental protection and is the only candidate who has changed Alameda policies to support LGBTQ+ residents, reduce environmental hazards, restrict investments in guns and carbon fuels, and make Alameda attractive for biotech startups.
As our next Mayor, Tracy’s priorities are Alameda priorities. We all deserve:
- A City that is Inclusive and Welcoming
- Street Designs That Improve Safety Without Increasing Traffic
- Housing Opportunities for All of Us
- An Economy that is Thriving
- A Balanced City Budget that is Responsibly Managed
- Infrastructure to Address the Challenges of Sea Level Rise and Be Prepared for Disasters
## In 2026, let’s ensure that Alameda’s best days are still to come.
## Vote Tracy Jensen for Alameda Mayor.

# Endorsements
### Our community is coming together in support of Tracy Jensen for Alameda Mayor.
Add your name today!
